warnings: CORRECTED 2026-08-24 — full pixel re-survey. This is a clean CAD sheet, so the grid pins exactly: x 1=918, 2=1309, 3=1624, 3'=1725 px (78.4 px/m) and y E=705, D=1017, C=1213, B=1525, A=1720 px (78.1 px/m), both scales agreeing to under 0.5%. Every vertical in every band was then found by coverage sweep and its mark read at 4x zoom.

TWO SYSTEMATIC ERRORS, both now fixed in all three bands. (1) The B2 verticals run on grid 3' (10.10), NOT grid 3 — their faces measure x=1696/1711 px while grid 3 sits at 1624. This is self-consistent with the B7X / B6X 1.10 m stubs already in this file, which are exactly the returns from grid 3 out to grid 3'. (2) What sits on grid 3 is B5 (E-D and C-B bands) or B1 (D-C band), which the earlier extraction had floating as '~2-3 interior' beams.

TWO BEAMS ON NAMED GRID 2 were missing or mislabelled: in the D-C band the beam recorded as '~1-2 interior' is actually the grid-2 vertical (faces x=1302/1318 px, hatched column boxes at D2 and C2 at both ends), and in the C-B band the grid-2 vertical was missing from the extraction entirely. Note that the E-D band genuinely has NO beam on grid 2 — only the dash-dot line runs between the E2 and D2 columns there, verified by a run trace that returns the dash pattern rather than a solid line.

Interior-beam COUNT per bay was wrong in the E-D band: the grid1-2 bay has TWO interior verticals (measured centres x=1072 and 1226 px, marks B3 then B4), not one, and the grid2-3 bay has ONE (x=1428, mark B4), not two. The missing B3 has been added.

⚠️ WHY THE INTERIOR BEAMS KEEP THEIR '~' REFS: their x-positions are not dimensioned anywhere in this house's structural set. The top margin prints only 5.00 / 4.00 / 1.10, and the footing plan (หน้า27) shows columns ONLY at the named grid intersections 1/2/3 x A/B/C/D/E — there are no interior columns to dimension. Measurement alone cannot decide between e.g. 1.95 and 2.00 at this scale (±0.05 m), so per the 'pos_m is always read from an actually-printed dimension, never guessed' rule no dummy columns were created. Their measured centres are recorded in each element's note as evidence. This does NOT affect span correctness: every interior beam here is a VERTICAL spanning a full band, so its length is the band height (4.00 / 2.50 / 4.00) whatever its x.

⚠️ NOT changed, flagged: the B-A band (the เฉลียง porch box) has its two verticals measured at x=979 and x=1247 px = about 0.78 m and 4.20 m, i.e. neither is on grid 1 (918) nor grid 2 (1309), yet B1 B1-A1 is recorded on grid 1. The box is undimensioned in the same way as the interior beams, so it was left rather than moved onto a guess.
Perimeter/edge beams (B1,B2,B3,B3A,B3X,B4X,B6,B6X,B7,B7X,B8) sit cleanly on the main grid or the 3'/E'/E'' dummies and are recorded at full confidence.

This sheet also shows a second interior tier of partition beams (extra B4/B5/B3/B1 occurrences framing individual rooms) whose x-position is NOT given by any printed dimension on this structural sheet -- only the 1-2(5.00)/2-3(4.00)/3-3'(1.10) chain is dimensioned. Resolving their exact sub-grid position needs the dimensioned architectural floor plan, which is out of op04 scope (Pass 3). These are recorded with an approximate '~' grid_ref (row band + which bay) and span_source:'unresolved' per the standing rule against inventing an un-printed position, rather than guessed as a fraction of the bay.

S3 (defined as a precast-plank type on S-16) was not found placed anywhere legible on this floor plan -- either unused in this house or in a densely-marked area I could not resolve at this scan resolution.

S2/S1/ST/SX slab-marker counts in dense areas (the laundry box and the row-A appendage) are read at reduced confidence, same caveat as house_04's S3 precedent -- exact tag count in a busy cluster is harder to verify than an isolated one.

Bare 'SP' circles scattered through most bays are the generic precast-plank symbol (this bay is floored in SP), not a distinct typed member -- not recorded as their own elements; the typed slab marks (S1/S2/ST/SX) are.

The laundry (ซักล้าง) box's own x-extent (west/east edges of B3X/B4X) is not dimensioned on this sheet -- recorded with grid_ref '~1' at the west edge (matches B3X sitting at the building's x=1 line) and an approximate/unresolved east position for B4X and the B2 top-cap segment closing the box; see grid master warnings.
